resources.string:
Chronicle Two plays from the files of your own copy of Dark Cloud 2 (Dark Chronicle). Make a disc image (ISO) of your PlayStation 2 disc, put it on this phone, and choose it here.

For now only the European (PAL) Dark Chronicle disc, SCES-51190, can be extracted: Chronicle Two is built from it, and the US and Japanese discs keep their data differently.

The game's data is converted out of the image once, which takes a while. The image itself is left as it is.
Copying the disc into the app: %1$s of %2$s MB
The file could not be read
This file has no PlayStation 2 disc\'s SYSTEM.CNF. Choose an ISO image of your Dark Cloud 2 disc.
This does not look like Dark Cloud 2 or Dark Chronicle. Extracting it will most likely fail.
For now Chronicle Two can only extract the European disc, Dark Chronicle (SCES-51190). This release keeps its data in other files, which the extractor does not read yet.
There is not enough free space: about %1$s GB is needed and %2$s GB is free.
Extract the game data now? It takes several minutes; keep the app open while it runs.
Choose both data.zip and data.json, as dc2data extract writes them on a computer (data.json says which version of the data they are; it has to match this version of Chronicle Two).
Drag a control to move it; touch one to set its size.
The last time it ran, Chronicle Two crashed or quit with an error. Its log says where; share it (or copy it and paste it) with whoever is fixing it.
